detection.keepRule: rise>=0.012 and prominence>=0.005, or rise>=0.030, or isolated(gapPrev>0.4s) with rise>=0.008 and prominence>0
detection.rmsOnlyRule: single local RMS max (+-3 frames) with jump>=0.04 over preceding median and no onset within -60/+120 ms

analysis.frequency: NOT DERIVABLE from onset/RMS data; frequencyHz is null for every event
analysis.sharpness: heuristic: sqrt(RMS rise per ms of attack / p95 of all events), clipped 0..1 (transients); envelope roughness*2 (continuous). Not spectral.
